exposure: Very early adolescent pregnancy (< 15 years at delivery)
cohort: The study cohort comprised mothers under 15 years of age at delivery compared to an appropriate control group of older gravidas.
finding: Very early adolescent pregnancies are associated with increased risks of small for gestational age, low birth weight, and preterm birth, but decreased risks of cesarean delivery, diabetes mellitus, and active phase disorders.
mod_finding: Very early adolescent pregnancies were associated with a decreased risk of cesarean section, with conflicting risks reported for episiotomy and instrumental delivery.
birth_weight: Low birth weight (< 2,500 gms), Very low birth weight
gest_age: Preterm birth (< 37 weeks), Small for gestational age
